ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.40:0.60 white-to-black pixel ratio. High-intensity white regions dominate the outer lateral lobes, while low-intensity black pixels are concentrated in the central peduncle-attachment region and leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white mottling regions extending from the mid-lobe to the distal tips. A solid black band follows the leading edge. The transition zone between black and white features high-frequency 'salt-and-pepper' pixel distribution.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude serrations. Notable large-scale notches (valleys) located at approximately 20% and 80% of the total wingspan. Micro-serrations are continuous across the entire boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep; the left lobe exhibits a more pronounced convex curvature on the trailing edge compared to the flatter, more linear trajectory of the right lobe's trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, circular white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, indicating clustered barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 4-5 parallel, high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel linear rake marks on the inner right lobe; significant structural irregularities at the distal tips due to barnacle encrustations and associated scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'hook' shape on the far right trailing edge tip; deep semi-circular notch on the far left trailing edge.
